links.to_node: The new dam is not constructed.
The coal-fired power plant is constructed by the major energy company.
Local ecosystems are disrupted by the coal-fired power plant.
Wildlife is killed or harmed due to the coal-fired power plant.
The region continues to rely on coal-fired power for energy.
Energy costs in the region remain higher than if the dam were built.
Air pollution increases due to coal-fired power plant emissions.
